description: The ONE input pin of the vendored @insimul/core bundle (corebridge/vendor/core/). tools/vendor-core-bundle.mjs bundles core at exactly `coreCommit` (a `git archive` of that commit, never the checkout's working tree) with exactly `esbuild`, and --check refuses a VENDORED.json that records anything else. Bump both here, then re-vendor.
coreRefNote: PL.native-camera-movement (2026-11-10, rulings U95(5), U95(3), U49(3) and U36): the pin moved from 72c658c to core main 431c95b, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after 72c658c — PL.movement-contract (89dd9ed: src/camera/movement-contract.ts, the movement contract the camera.movement.* rows run, with its corpus conformance/camera/movement.json, now copied as the camera set), PL.ground-from-ir (91a180d: the host reads placeAt and groundSurfaceAt from the World IR, stated with the corpus conformance/audio/ground.json, which no row here runs), PL.corpus-provenance-scrub (e10a376, 0464f30: core's corpus sources lines and packs/index.json name no private repository path, so the vendored copies here name none either), PL.interactables-cases (1a592da: interactables.json 27 -> 33, four target cases whose answer depends on the stated ranges and two interact cases that state a lone prop), PL.core-props-docs (3857c6c: doors.json 29 -> 30, a turned-tavern session case, and the contract's interiorFrame) and PL.movement-followups (431c95b: a follow mode's sight line with no view yaw is refused as missing-view-yaw, and the slopeAtRest op; movement.json 87 cases). Before that, PL.native-interact-target (2026-11-10, rulings U94(3), U49(3) and U36): the pin moved from 7376894 to core main 72c658c, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after 7376894 — PL.examine-props (91ebc8d, 2158b08: src/props/interactables.ts, the interact rule the props.interactables.* rows run, with its corpus conformance/props/interactables.json, 27 cases, now copied with the other props corpora), PL.disk-changed-step (4099a14, c74c1fe, 1a0667b: the SaveSlotsSession disk_changed step, which saves.slots.apply now takes as op disk_changed { slots }; slots.json 130 -> 147 cases and title-flow.json 56 -> 57), P9i.core (eadbf0e..abe0293: the progression pack, packs/progression/pack.json, and one composition case), PL.pickup-ring-search-case (4d4c0df: six ring cases that state a search; pickup-placement.json 66 -> 72) and PL.tutorial-corpus-bundle (72c658c: the *-corpus-host modules the ui.titleFlow and ui.tutorial rows now import, so the bundle reaches no save module). Before that, PL.native-title-rows (2026-11-10, rulings U92(1) and U36): core main was still 7376894, so the pin did not move; P8.core's title menu (src/ui/title-flow.ts), tutorial quest (TutorialQuestSystem) and onboarding flow (OnboardingManager) were already in it (ff599d7), and the ui.titleFlow.*, ui.tutorial.* and ui.onboarding.* rows run them, with their corpora conformance/ui/title-flow.json (56 cases) and conformance/quests/tutorial.json (40) now copied beside the others. Before that, PL.native-genre-hud-config (2026-11-10, rulings U92(2) and U36): the pin moved from eff846a to 7376894, core main since (6c6d4a4: the ops and cases; 7376894: a test that only a GenreResolutionError becomes a refusal; both landed on core main eff846a by checked fast-forward): core's runGenreHudOp gains the ops config_of and view_of (a game's own settings — a stated genreConfig, or a recipe on its world through resolveGameGenre — projected by genreHudConfigOf, alone or composed with view), with 43 new cases in conformance/ui/genre-hud-cases.json (63 -> 106; the 63 earlier cases unchanged), which the ui.genreHud row passes through unchanged because it checks only op against core's GENRE_HUD_OPS. Before that, PL.native-pickup-settle (2026-11-10, rulings U91(2) and U89(3)): the pin moved from ac229a7 to core main eff846a, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after ac229a7 — P9g.core (044365e..4729bbc), P9h.core (333b15c..7c477e8), P9f.core (b56d53f..04285d6), PL.p9f-corpus-gaps (3d56b12..d1a0943), PL.quick-slot-one-based (56c6954: a stated quickSlot is the 1-based slot number, which resolveSaveSlotsConfig maps to the session's 0-based index; 0 is refused quick_slot_out_of_range, so the saves.slots hand case states quickSlot 1 where it stated 0), PL.find-text-events (14456ea), PL.vehicle-events (8879868), PL.prolog-helper-align (64b0deb), PL.recipe-source-hashes (2782ff6, f30f84e) and PL.quest-converter-gaps (dcccc1e, eff846a) — and the props.pickups.* rows run core's pick-up placement (PL.pickup-placement, cd38a56 and ac229a7, already in at ac229a7: src/props/pickup-placement.ts) with its corpus conformance/props/pickup-placement.json, now copied with the P6 corpora. Before that, PL.native-props-rows (2026-11-09, rulings U89(2) and U36): the pin moved from fc88be9 to core main ac229a7, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after fc88be9 — P9b.core (101ff6a..d337ba5), P9c.core (f4efdba..4987cba), P9d.core (c66a793), P9e.core (2a84fc0, 6f51dc2), PL.adventure-combat-revert (3ce594c), PL.slots-delete-states (2e1706a: the delete prompt, whose ask_delete, confirm_delete and cancel_delete steps the saves.slots.apply row now takes, and a finished delete's history line), PL.quick-slot (895d2d9..280693b: an unset quickSlot is a dedicated quick slot at index slotCount), PL.read-clue-events (344c40c) and PL.pickup-placement (cd38a56, ac229a7) — and P6.core's props and inventory logic (31764b1: src/props/{containers,documents,doors,notice-board}.ts, src/ui/inventory-model.ts, game-engine/logic/NoticeGenerator.ts) with its corpora conformance/props/{containers,documents,doors,notice-board}.json and conformance/ui/inventory-cases.json, which the props.* and inventory.* rows run. Before that, PL.native-catchup (2026-11-09, rulings U87(4) and U84): the pin moved from f9aef13 to core main fc88be9, which holds every core item the Unreal-first queue landed after f9aef13 — PL.collect-target (6b07b9f), PL.criteria-quests (8f12efd), PL.core-mechanics-contract (798d333: MECHANIC_STEP_OPS exported as data from src/game-engine/mechanic-runtime-corpus.ts, which the mechanics.run row now imports in place of its hand copy, and the World IR's meta.enabledModules ['none'] token, which mechanics.run and modules.activate answer through core), PL.slots-offset-mirror (8ae718b), PL.weather-look-light (5179d0b), PL.save-weather (9caa203), PL.pass-by-core (556368c) and PL.house-blank-sides (fc88be9) — and P1.core-slots' SaveSlotsSession (a301b9d, src/save-slots.ts) with its corpus conformance/saves/slots.json, which the saves.slots.create and saves.slots.apply rows run. Before that, P9a.native (2026-11-07, rulings U84 and U79(4)): the pin moved from b38e60d to core main f9aef13, which holds P9a.core (a4b3aaf..00fc64a: every registry genre activates its mechanics, a world's meta.enabledModules reaches the activation, the genre HUD view-model and its corpus conformance/ui/genre-hud-cases.json, the world rules panel and its corpus conformance/ui/rules-panel-cases.json, and the mechanic runtime assembly src/game-engine/mechanic-runtime.ts with its corpus conformance/modules/mechanic-runtime.json) that the ui.genreHud, ui.rulesPanel and mechanics.run rows run, and levels the vendored packs/ trees with core (U81). Before that, SP.composer-native (2026-11-05, rulings U62(1) and U79(4)): the pin moved from 4a46789 to core main b38e60d, which holds SP.composer's composer (4ca7e9e, src/system-packs/composer.ts) and its corpus (conformance/packs/composition.json, 34 cases, with the packs/ catalog it names) that the packs.compose row runs. Before that, L.native-layout (2026-10-29, ruling U36): the pin moved from c4b46c4 to core main 4a46789, which holds L1's layout rules (bdfe79d, src/editor/layout/) and B9's composition rules (5d05c18 onward, src/editor/layout/composition/) that the layout.* rows run. Before that, the C0 landing (2026-10-16) pinned c4b46c4. To move it again: bump coreCommit and coreRef here, re-vendor, re-run --check --core and the corebridge, layout, packs, P9a (genre HUD with config_of/view_of), saves-slots, props, pick-up, interactables, title-flow and tutorial corpus ctests.
